findings: the reported interface flux is not a constant multiple of the normal derivative of this side's own submitted field, at level 3 side B. For a scalar conduction flux q_n = -k du/dn the ratio must be the conductivity at EVERY interface point; a varying ratio means the flux and the field did not come from one another. Export the flux from the same assembled system that produced the field.

the two subdomains disagree at the interface: max relative field jump 1.236e-07, max relative FLUX jump 9.956e-02. the jump does not shrink under refinement (field [5.572e-08, 7.774e-09, 1.236e-07], flux [9.956e-02, 9.956e-02, 9.956e-02]). A jump that stays O(1) under refinement means the scheme converged to a fixed point of the wrong transmission condition — which the observed order cannot see, because convergence to a wrong answer is still convergence.
